verdict.rationale: Telemetry opt-out is a fair question for a GPU product, since it ships companion software (AMD Software, ROCm) that could collect usage data. The evidence pack never documents any telemetry or usage-tracking setting or opt-out. Mentions of a 'private' local ML workstation, offline runfile installation and open-source inspectability are adjacent features, not an opt-out control, so they earn no credit.
